messages:
support_jen: fyi customer @AcmeInc reports p99 latency on /v1/generate with model hypatia-extended-3b after yesterday's onboarding. started ~08:12 UTC, spike from ~120ms to ~2.6s p99. they see it on long docs (20k tokens).

maria_gonzalez: logged a ticket and customer supplied sample payloads + curl repro. dropping here.

support_jen: paste of their curl:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \ 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ 
  -d '{"model":"hypatia-extended-3b","input":"<customer_long_logs>...~20k chars..."}'
```

ian_wright: thanks. initial quick checks: no infra OOMs, pods healthy. grafana shows a p99 jump exactly at 2024-11-21T08:11:30 UTC on nodes serving the new model pool. link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ai/hypatia-extended (private)

ml_tara: model change note: this variant uses a new byte-level tokenizer (v2) we added to support unicode-normalized traces. QA run passed on 4k seqs but long-context tests were limited.

alex_chang: interesting — logs show a lot more tokens emitted for the same text with v2 tokenizer (roughly 1.4x tokens) which could increase KV cache pressure and change kernel selection.

sre_sam: is it token count or specific sequences causing slow path? can we repro locally with their sample?

maria_gonzalez: repro attached in case folder. trying now on canary infra. will report back.

eng_oncall_bot: deploy notice: hypatia-extended-3b rolled to pool-prod-7 @ 2024-11-21T08:05:12 UTC by @ml_tara (canary->gradual).

maria_gonzalez: running their payload against canary (same hardware) -> local p99 2.4s, p95 ~650ms. baseline model hypatia-stable-3b p99 ~140ms on same input.

ian_wright: captured runtime trace (summarized):
- tokenization step increases from ~12ms -> ~55ms
- first token generation slower due to kv cache warmup + larger kv (size ~1.4x)
- repeated attention kernels hitting fallback path around sequence length ~8k
- backend switching to slower CUDA kernel at longer sequences

alex_chang: here's the snippet from the runtime logs showing kernel fallback:
```
[2024-11-21T08:11:31Z] kernel_selector: selected kernel "attn_opt_v1" for seq=4096
[2024-11-21T08:11:31Z] kernel_selector: fallback to "attn_generic" due to large head count and kv_shard mismatch
[2024-11-21T08:11:31Z] runtime: kv_cache size 1.4x expected, latency spike on step=1
```

ml_tara: oh — kv_shard mismatch. we changed default shard_count for this model to 2 in the model config (to optimize memory) but pool nodes expect shard_count=1. that can cause cross-device fetches and slowdowns. I missed that in the rollout checklist.

sre_sam: that explains cross-device syncs. immediate mitigation options:
- revert routing to hypatia-stable for customers requiring long context (fast)
- pause rollout and set model pool to accept shard_count=2 nodes only (slow to provision)
- add temporary autoscale to decrease per-request queueing

support_jen: customer is asking for a quick patch since production UX is impacted. they prefer a fallback to older model while we fix.

ian_wright: quick triage steps I did:
1) forced request routing for customer to fallback model hypatia-stable-3b (done at 08:40 UTC).
2) re-run their payload against hypatia-stable-3b -> p99 back to ~150ms.
3) captured heap/kv usage and kernel logs for ingested requests.

eng_oncall_bot: route change applied: customer AcmeInc pinned to hypatia-stable-3b via routing rule rule-rt-992 at 2024-11-21T08:41:03 UTC.

maria_gonzalez: customer confirmed degradation stopped after routing change. they still want root cause & timeline for a fix.

alex_chang: permanent fix options:
- reconfigure model artifact to use shard_count=1 for pool-prod (would be simplest).
- update node runtime to support cross-shard fast path (more engineering work but good long-term).
- adjust tokenizer v2 to emit fewer tokens in long context mode (risky).

ml_tara: leaning toward updating the model artifact back to shard_count=1 and re-running canary with explicit long-context testcases. we'll keep v2 tokenizer but add a token budget hint for long sessions.

sre_sam: after revert, we should run a smoke test backlog: sequence lengths 1k, 4k, 8k, 20k with both tokenizers. add perf regression alerts to prevent similar rollouts.

ian_wright: I've opened a follow-up: issue INF-6421 "hypatia-extended onboarding: kv_shard mismatch -> p99 spike" assigned to ml_tara and alex_chang. includes logs + reproducer.

ml_tara: ETA to revert artifact and pause rollout: 2hrs (need to coordinate deploy and canary). will post updates.

support_jen: communicated to customer: temporary routing put in place, we will revert model shard config and re-run long-context perf tests before re-enabling. thanks all. :bow:

deploybot: canary deploy scheduled: revert-hypatia-shard -> pool-prod-7 at 2024-11-21T10:35 UTC (manual approval required).

maria_gonzalez: leaving this thread open until postmortem. will ask customer for permission to share anonymized logs in the postmortem.

sre_sam: follow-up action items (short):
- [ ] ml: revert shard_count in artifact + run canary with long traces (ml_tara)
- [ ] eng: add shard mismatch check to rollout validation (alex_chang)
- [ ] infra: add long-context perf gates in CI (ian_wright)
- [ ] support: confirm customer ok with postmortem (support_jen)

support_jen: if anyone needs the exact customer payload, I can drop it into the secure incident bucket (PII scrubbed).
